title: Understanding How Value Neurons Shape the Generation of Specified Values in LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces ValueLocate and ValueInsight, a framework and benchmark designed to identify and evaluate 'value neurons' in LLMs. It is grounded in the Schwartz Values Survey, which operationalizes universal human values and ethical orientations. The research specifically addresses alignment with ethical principles and uses datasets focused on moral dilemmas and value-based judgments.
